title: The Midnight House
description: A Victorian mansion hides dark secrets. Will you uncover the truth or become just another ghost?

node-1.title: Arrival
node-1.narration: You stand before the iron gates of the Midnight House. Fog swirls around your ankles, cold and clammy. The letter said to come alone, after dark. 'I know what you did last summer,' the note read in shaky lettering. 'Come to Blackwood Manor if you want to keep it a secret.' The massive house looms against the dark sky, a solitary light flickering in one of the second-floor windows. The gate stands slightly ajar, as if inviting you in... or luring you into a trap.

choice-1.text: Enter through the main gate and head for the front door

choice-2.text: Walk around the perimeter looking for another entrance

node-2.title: Front Entrance
node-2.narration: Gravel crunches under your shoes as you walk up the path. The wind moans through the twisted branches of old oak trees. You climb the stone steps to the massive oak door. A gargoyle-shaped knocker stares at you with empty eyes. You reach out to knock, but the door creaks open on its own, revealing a dark vestibule. The smell of old paper and withered flowers wafts out.

choice-3.text: Step into the hall and call out to the host

choice-4.text: Stay on the porch and wait for someone to appear

node-3.title: Garden Shadows
node-3.narration: You decide not to go straight to the front door. Instead, you creep through the tall grass to the side of the house. It is dark here, moonlight barely piercing the thick clouds. You stumble upon an old greenhouse, its glass broken and grimy. Inside, strange, unnatural shadows of plants seem to be moving. Nearby is a servants' entrance that looks less imposing than the main one.

node-4.title: Grand Hall
node-4.narration: You step inside. 'Hello? Is anyone there?' Your voice echoes off the high walls. The door slams shut behind you. You pull the handle - locked. You are trapped. The only light comes from a chandelier above, flickering weakly. Before you is a wide staircase leading up, and dark corridors to the left and right.

choice-7.text: Climb the stairs to the first floor

node-5.title: Waiting
node-5.narration: You decide to wait. Minutes pass and feel like hours. The cold seeps into your bones. Suddenly, you hear a whisper close to your ear: 'Why do you make us wait?' You spin around, but there is no one. When you look back at the door, a tall figure in a dark coat stands in the doorway. 'You're late,' the figure says in a voice like grinding stones. 'Dinner is served.'

choice-10.text: Push the figure and try to run

node-6.title: Kitchen
node-6.narration: The servants' door opens with a groan of protest. You find yourself in a vast, abandoned kitchen. Rows of copper pots gleam dimly in the moonlight. On a large chopping table sits a fresh red apple, looking oddly out of place amidst the dust and cobwebs. From deeper in the house come the sounds of soft footsteps.

choice-12.text: Grab a knife from the table and move towards the sound

node-7.title: Greenhouse
node-7.narration: You wipe the grimy glass and peer inside. The plants within are... moving, though there is no wind. These are no ordinary flowers; their vines twist like snakes, and the buds look like tiny mouths. In the center of the greenhouse is a statue of a woman that seems to be looking right at you. Suddenly, one of the vines smashes through the glass and grabs your arm!

choice-13.text: Try to break free and run for the servants' door

choice-14.text: Use a lighter to scare the plant

node-8.title: First Floor
node-8.narration: You climb the creaking stairs. At the top is a long hallway with many doors. The room you saw the light from outside is at the very end. A soft music box melody is drifting from a room on the right.

choice-15.text: Go to the lit room at the end of the hall

choice-16.text: Check the room with the music

node-9.title: Library
node-9.narration: The left corridor leads you into a massive library. Floor-to-ceiling shelves are packed with old books. Embers still glow in the fireplace, though no one is there. On a table lies an open diary. You read the last entry: 'They have come for me. I can hide no longer. The secret is in the portrait.'

choice-17.text: Examine the portrait above the fireplace

choice-18.text: Read the previous pages of the diary

node-10.title: Dining Room
node-10.narration: The figure leads you into the dining room. A long table is set for one. 'Sit,' the host commands. You notice there is no food on the plate, but an old, yellowed photograph... of you. Taken yesterday. 'We have been watching you,' he says.

choice-20.text: Flip the table and create chaos

node-11.title: Escape
node-11.narration: You push the figure. It feels hard and cold as wood. The figure doesn't fall, but you manage to slip past. You sprint back to the gate, but it is locked. The bars are too high to climb. You hear heavy footsteps behind you.

node-12.title: Pantry
node-12.narration: You squeeze yourself into a narrow pantry smelling of mold. Through a crack in the door, you see a woman in a Victorian maid's uniform enter the kitchen. She is humming a creepy lullaby. She picks up the apple, and her face changes - her jaw drops unnaturally low, revealing rows of sharp teeth.

choice-23.text: Hold your breath and hope she leaves

choice-24.text: Jump out and attack while she is distracted

node-13.title: Armed
node-13.narration: Clutching the rusty knife tight, you creep towards the sound. It leads you to a servants' corridor. Ahead, you see light spilling from under a door. Voices are arguing inside. 'He won't come,' one says. 'He must,' another replies. 'The ritual requires his blood.'

node-14.title: Fire
node-14.narration: You flick the lighter. The flame flares up and the plant recoils with a shriek. The fire catches onto nearby dry leaves. The whole greenhouse starts filling with smoke. A door leading to the house opens and someone runs out coughing.

choice-27.text: Take advantage of the confusion and enter the house

node-15.title: Master's Room
node-15.narration: You reach the end of the hall and push the door open. The room is lit by candles. In the center stands an old man. 'I have been waiting for you, Anton,' he says (though that is not your name, or is it...?). 'It is time to pay the debt.'

choice-29.text: Say he has the wrong person

choice-30.text: Ask what debt he is talking about

node-16.title: Nursery
node-16.narration: The source of the music is an old nursery. In the center of the room is a crib rocking by itself. A music box on the shelf plays 'Baa, Baa, Black Sheep', but in a minor key. You approach the crib and look inside. It is empty, save for a mirror lying at the bottom.

node-17.title: Conversation with the Dead
node-17.narration: You press your hands to the wall and speak directly to the presence behind it. 'Samuel? If that is your name, I want to understand what happened to you.' The scratching stops. Silence. Then a voice comes, young and desperate, sounding as if through wood from very far away: 'He killed her. Said it was for her own good, but he killed her slowly. Killed me slowly too. Made me watch myself die in pieces.' Your voice trembles as you ask: 'What do you want?' The answer comes immediately: 'I want him to feel what I felt. Every moment. Every day. Until he understands that death is a mercy.' You realize with a sinking feeling that Samuel isn't trapped. He is in control. The whole house is his now: an extension of his will, his pain, his need for punishment. 'Bring me someone,' Samuel whispers. 'Bring me someone new. Someone whose life burns bright. If you do, he will let you go. You can have your freedom.' Your hands drop from the wall. You have been offered a pact. Betray another or remain trapped yourself.

choice-33.text: Refuse the pact and find another way out

choice-34.text: Accept Samuel's terms and hunt for a victim

node-18.title: Secret Passage
node-18.narration: You flip through the diary backwards. The pages are filled with mad drawings of eyes and doors. A note catches your eye: 'Behind the fireplace is a passage. Must press the cracked brick.' You look at the fireplace.

choice-36.text: Ignore it and look for another exit from the library

node-19.title: The Truth
node-19.narration: The host laughs, a dry, cracking sound. 'Explanation? You are not here to ask questions. You are here to be part of the collection.' The walls begin to shift, revealing niches containing the preserved bodies of previous guests.

node-20.title: Chaos
node-20.narration: You flip the heavy oak table with all your might. Crockery flies onto the floor with a deafening crash. The host hisses like an angry cat and retreats into the shadows. 'Fool! You broke the urn!' he screams. From the shards of a broken vase, gray smoke rises.

choice-39.text: Run for the exit while he is distracted

node-21.title: Garden Maze
node-21.narration: The bushes turn out to be part of an old maze. You dive in, branches scratching your face. Footsteps boom behind you, then fall silent. You are lost. Only high hedges all around.

choice-42.text: Try to break through the hedge

node-22.title: Greenhouse Ghost
node-22.narration: You run to the greenhouse, but the door is locked. Inside, you see the figure of a girl banging her fists on the glass. 'Don't come in!' she screams soundlessly. But the pursuer's steps are very close now.

node-23.title: Discovery
node-23.narration: The maid leaves, muttering about 'fresh meat'. You exhale. The way to the kitchen is clear now, but the door she exited through leads to the cellar.

choice-46.text: Go up into the house through the kitchen

node-24.title: Confrontation
node-24.narration: You jump out with a yell. The creature screams with an inhuman voice and lunges at you. You manage to strike it with something heavy, and it turns to dust. But the noise has definitely attracted attention.

node-25.title: The Ritual
node-25.narration: You burst into the room. Five hooded figures stand around a pentagram. They turn their heads towards you. 'A volunteer,' the leader says. 'How kind.'

node-26.title: Secret Knowledge
node-26.narration: You listen. They are talking about how the house feeds on fear. The only way to defeat it is not to be afraid. 'If he laughs, the spell breaks,' one voice says.

choice-51.text: Walk in and tell a joke

node-27.title: Into the House
node-27.narration: Taking advantage of the panic, you slip through the open door. You find yourself in a corridor with paintings whose eyes follow you.

node-28.title: Rescue
node-28.narration: You grab the person's hand and pull them out. It's a young boy, terrified. 'Thank you,' he gasps. 'I know where the exit is. A secret tunnel.'

choice-56.text: Don't trust him and go alone

node-29.title: Decision
node-29.narration: You refuse the pact firmly. 'I won't become like him. And I won't be your puppet.' Samuel screams in rage, the walls shaking. 'Then stay here forever!' The floor beneath you collapses.

node-30.title: New Master
node-30.narration: You agree. 'Wise choice,' Samuel whispers. The door opens. Standing in the hallway is the same boy you saved from the greenhouse (or could have). He looks at you hopefully. You grip the knife handle in your pocket...

choice-59.text: Fulfill your end of the bargain

choice-60.text: Change your mind at the last second and attack the 'presence'

node-31.title: The Mirror
node-31.narration: You pick up the mirror. In the reflection you see not yourself, but a ghost looking over your shoulder. He smiles and puts a finger to his lips.

node-32.title: The Crib
node-32.narration: You stop the crib with your hand. The music stops abruptly. Silence presses on your ears. Suddenly, the crib begins to shake with savage force, and a loud, piercing baby's cry tears through the air.

ending-1.title: Eternal Guest
ending-1.narration: You couldn't escape. The house swallowed you, just like so many others. You are now part of the collection, another ghost wandering the halls and scaring new guests. Maybe next time you'll be luckier... but for you, there is no next time.

ending-2.title: Freedom... or not?
ending-2.narration: You run out the gate, lungs burning from the cold air. You don't stop until you reach the town. You survived. But every night you dream of this house. And sometimes, when you look in the mirror, you see a shadow with coal-like eyes over your shoulder. You left the Midnight House, but has it left you?

ending-3.title: The Heir
ending-3.narration: You performed the ritual. You made the sacrifice. The house has accepted you. You are the new master now. Ancient and dark power flows through your veins. You watch from the window as new guests arrive. 'Welcome,' you whisper with a smile. Dinner is served.

ending-4.title: Curse Breaker
ending-4.narration: Your courage (or foolishness) broke the spell. Laughter, fearlessness, or maybe fire - something worked. The house began to crumble brick by brick, dissolving into the morning mist. You stand in an empty field, where the manor just stood. It is over. The curse is lifted.

ending-5.title: The Forgotten
ending-5.narration: You hid too well. No one found you. No one came for you. You stayed in the dark, waiting for a rescue that never came. Over time you forgot your name. You forgot what the sun looks like. You just became another shadow in the corner.

ending-6.title: Deal with the Devil
ending-6.narration: You made a deal with Samuel. You are free, rich, and successful. But the price was heavy. In every shadow you see the faces of those you betrayed. And you know that when your time comes, Samuel will come to collect the debt. And the interest will be terrible.

author: Marcus Vincent
